series.name: RAC CH codes from LG official help library guide to error codes
series.notes: LG USA Help Library 'Air Conditioner Guide to Error Codes' (official, high) + Kenya/Nigeria mirrors. CH## family used on wired remotes/displays. No PK-localized table found; same code family.

meaning.en: Condensate not draining (ceiling/wall) or tank full (window/portable shows CH04/FL).
meaning.ur: Condensate drain nahi ho raha (ceiling/wall) ya tank bhar gaya (window/portable par CH04/FL aata hai)

causes.en: Indoor drain path blocked or drain pump problem (ceiling type)
causes.ur: Ceiling type mein drain line block ya drain pump kharab

causes.en: High humidity / rainy day exceeding evaporation (window/portable)
causes.ur: Zyada humidity ya barsaat mein evaporation se zyada paani (window/portable)

causes.en: Full tank needs manual drain
causes.ur: Tank bhar gaya ho to haath se drain karna zaroori hai

solutions.en: Power cycle 5 minutes; if persists request service (ceiling)
solutions.ur: 5 minute power cycle karein; phir bhi rahe to service request karein (ceiling)

solutions.en: Window/portable: power off, open rear drain port(s), drain into ~1.5L pan, refit cap; optional 18mm LG hose
solutions.ur: Window/portable: power off karein, peeche drain port kholein, ~1.5L pan mein paani nikalein, cap wapas lagayein; optional 18mm LG hose

solutions.en: Frequent CH04/FL even on dry days = inspect product
solutions.ur: Sukhein dinon mein bhi CH04/FL baar baar aaye to product check karo

notes.en: Drain behavior differs by product type.
notes.ur: Drain ka behaviour product ke hisab se alag hota hai.

meaning.en: Communication error between indoor and outdoor units of inverter ACs.
meaning.ur: Inverter AC ke indoor aur outdoor units ke beech communication error

causes.en: Triggered shortly after installing or relocating the unit (wiring/piping)
causes.ur: Unit ke install ya shift karne ke foran baad (wiring/piping)

causes.en: Unstable power supply or electrical issues during normal use
causes.ur: Aam istemal ke dauran bijli ka supply stable nahi rehta

causes.en: Fault persists after power cycle = hardware/comms line fault
causes.ur: Power cycle ke baad bhi rahe to hardware ya communication line fault

solutions.en: If after install: contact installation technician to check piping connections
solutions.ur: Naya install hua ho to installation technician se piping/wiring check karwaayein

solutions.en: If during normal use: unplug/breaker off 5 minutes, restore; if returns request service
solutions.ur: Aam istemaal mein: 5 minute band karein, phir wapas aaye to service request karein

solutions.en: Note: some models show EO when kW Manager runs — not a fault
solutions.ur: Note: kuch models mein kW Manager chalte waqt EO dikhta hai — yeh fault nahi

notes.en: Same physical fault family as Universal 05/53.
notes.ur: Yeh Universal 05/53 ke hi physical fault family se hai.

title.en: Operating mode conflict between indoor units
title.ur: Indoor units ke darmiyan operating mode conflict

meaning.en: 2-in-1 or multi rooms running conflicting modes (heat vs cool/dehumid).
meaning.ur: 2-in-1 ya multi mein kamre alag alag conflicting mode par chale (heat vs cool/dehumidify)

causes.en: Standing unit cooling while wall unit heats (or reverse)
causes.ur: Standing unit cooling karta hai aur wall unit heating karti hai (ya ulta bhi ho sakta hai)

causes.en: Different rooms set to opposite modes
causes.ur: Alag alag kamre bilkul alag modes par set hain

solutions.en: Match all units: cooling+cooling, cooling+dehumid, dehumid+dehumid, heating+heating OK
solutions.ur: tmam yont ayk mod par kary

solutions.en: Heating paired with cooling/dehumid = CH07
solutions.ur: Heating ke sath cooling/dehumidify = CH07

solutions.en: Air purification and fan modes always allowed
solutions.ur: Air purification aur fan ke modes hamesha chal sakte hain

notes.en: Full official mode matrix available on source page.
notes.ur: Poora official mode matrix source page par maujood hai.

codes.blinkPattern: CH07; indoor indicator may blink at 2s intervals

meaning.en: Air conditioner low on refrigerant; warning to protect appliance from damage.
meaning.ur: Air conditioner mein refrigerant kam hai; gharz se bachane ke liye warning

causes.en: Error after installing or relocating — likely shortage or piping leak
causes.ur: Install ya shift ke baad error — gas ki kami ya piping leak

causes.en: Leak developed during use
causes.ur: astamal ke doran lyk

causes.en: Transient electrical issue only if it clears after power cycle
causes.ur: Sirf tabhi masla electrical hai jab power cycle se theek ho jaye

solutions.en: If after install: contact installation technician for piping/leak check
solutions.ur: Install ke baad: installation technician se piping/leak check karwaayein

solutions.en: If during normal use: power cycle 5 minutes; if reappears contact LG support
solutions.ur: Aam istemaal mein: 5 minute power cycle karein; wapas aaye to LG support se rabta karein

solutions.en: Do not keep running low — compressor damage risk
solutions.ur: Gas kam par chalna band na karein — compressor kharab hone ka khatra hai

notes.en: Africa official also groups CH32/33/36/38/F4 as refrigerant family.
notes.ur: Africa official CH32/33/36/38/F4 ko refrigerant family ke tor par group karta hai.

title.en: Reverse phase / phase issue after power event
title.ur: paor ayont ke bad alta fyz

meaning.en: Reverse phase detection; often after temporary outage or electrical work.
meaning.ur: Reverse phase detection — aam tor par temporary outage ya electrical kaam ke baad

causes.en: Temporary power outage or electrical work left phases wrong
causes.ur: Temporary power outage ya electrical kaam ke baad phases galat chhor diye gaye

causes.en: Supply side phase rotation wrong
causes.ur: Supply side par phase sequence galat

solutions.en: Reset air conditioner circuit breaker
solutions.ur: Air conditioner ka circuit breaker reset karein

solutions.en: If persists, unit needs inspection
solutions.ur: Phir bhi rahe to unit ki inspection zaroori hai

solutions.en: If after electrical work, tell contractor it is reverse phase detection
solutions.ur: Agar electrical kaam ke baad hua ho to contractor ko bataayein ke yeh reverse phase detection hai

notes.ur: Yeh Universal 54 ke 3-phase mein reverse ya missing phase wale fault se milta hai.

title.ur: Zyada garmi se protection (outdoor high / indoor high)

meaning.en: Cooling: outdoor unit too hot (poor ventilation). Heating: indoor internal temp too high (dirty filter / poor intake).
meaning.ur: Cooling mein: outdoor unit bohat garam (ventilation kam). Heating mein: indoor ka andar temperature zyada (ganda filter ya hawa ka kam aana)

causes.en: Enclosed balcony, closed ventilation window, clutter around ODU
causes.ur: Bandi balcony, band ventilation window, ya ODU ke aas paas saamaan

causes.en: ODU lower/far from ventilation window causing hot air recirculation
causes.ur: ODU ventilation window se neeche ya door — garam hawa wapas ghoom rahi hai

causes.en: Clogged indoor filter in heating mode
causes.ur: Heating mode mein indoor filter ganda/clogged

solutions.en: Open ventilation window/insect screen; clear space around ODU; align height; fit air guide (LG tested ~6-8C cooler)
solutions.ur: Ventilation window/insect screen kholein, ODU ke aas-paas jagah khali rakhein, height theek karein aur air guide lagayein (LG ke test mein ~6-8C tak thanda)

solutions.en: Clean indoor filter in heating case
solutions.ur: Heating mein indoor filter saaf karein

solutions.en: Error does NOT auto-clear — power cycle 5 minutes; if persists technician
solutions.ur: Error khud clear nahi hota — 5 minute power cycle karein; phir bhi rahe to technician bulayein

notes.ur: Aliases model ke hisab se badalte hain, har model mein alag ho sakte hain.

title.en: Inverter detects comms line or piping fault
title.ur: Inverter ke comms line ya piping ka fault

meaning.en: Inverter model feature detecting indoor-outdoor communication or piping connection problems.
meaning.ur: Inverter model ki khaas feature jo indoor-outdoor communication ya piping connection ki kharabi batati hai

causes.en: Appeared right after new install or relocation
causes.ur: Naye install ya shift ke foran baad aaya

causes.en: Temporary fault from unstable power during normal use
causes.ur: Normal use mein bijli ke unstable hone se temporary fault

causes.en: Actual open/short on communication or pipe sensor harness
causes.ur: Asal mein communication ya pipe sensor harness par open/short

solutions.en: After install: contact installation technician to check piping
solutions.ur: Install ke baad: installation technician se piping check karwaayein

solutions.en: Normal use: power cycle ~5 minutes; if persists service inspection
solutions.ur: aam astamal: ~5 mnt ry syt baqy rhai to sros

solutions.en: Verify both units powered (post-2021 dual power cord models)
solutions.ur: Dono units bijli par hon (2021 ke baad dual power cord models)

notes.en: Africa official groups CH66 with CH90/91/92/93 test-run family.
notes.ur: Africa official CH66 ko CH90/91/92/93 test-run family ke sath group karta hai.

meaning.en: CH10/E6 caused by indoor unit fan problems.
meaning.ur: CH10/E6 indoor unit fan ki kharabi se aata hai.

causes.en: Debris or snow buildup around indoor fan
causes.ur: Indoor fan ke aas paas gadda ya barf jama hua

causes.en: Fan motor or feedback fault (see Universal 10)
causes.ur: Fan motor ya feedback kharab

causes.en: Visible obstruction only source suggests first
causes.ur: Sirf nazar aane wali rokawat ho to pehli wali baat likhi hai

solutions.en: Remove debris/snow around fan components
solutions.ur: Fan ke aas paas ka gadda/barf hata dein

solutions.en: If no visible issue, service may be required
solutions.ur: Agar koi nazar aane wala masla na ho to service karwaana zaroori ho sakta hai

solutions.en: If persists contact service technician
solutions.ur: Masla baqi rahe to service technician se rabta karein

notes.en: Cross-ref Universal code 10 for full diagnostics.
notes.ur: Poori diagnostics ke liye Universal code 10 dekhein.

meaning.en: CH67/EF related to outdoor unit fan.
meaning.ur: CH67/EF outdoor unit fan se mutaalliq hai

causes.en: Debris or snow around outdoor fan
causes.ur: Outdoor fan ke aas paas gadda ya barf

causes.en: Fan motor lock or drive fault
causes.ur: Fan motor lock ya drive fault

solutions.en: Remove obstructions around outdoor fan
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan ke aas-paas ki rukaawat hatayein

solutions.en: If nothing visible, request technician
solutions.ur: Agar kuch nazar na aaye to technician bulaayein

solutions.en: Full checks: hall sensor, windings, PCB output (Universal 67)
solutions.ur: Poori check-list: hall sensor, windings aur PCB output check karein (Universal 67)

title.ur: Test-run phase error (piping aur comms check)

meaning.en: Typically displayed during test-run to prevent damage; some models show F4.
meaning.ur: Aam tor par test-run ke doran damage se bachane ke liye aata hai; kuch models F4 dikhate hain

causes.en: Triggered shortly after install or relocation — piping connection issue
causes.ur: Install ya shift ke foran baad — piping connection masla

causes.en: Unstable power during normal use (temporary)
causes.ur: Aam istemal ke dauran bijli unstable rahti hai (arzi masla)

solutions.en: After install: consult installation technician for piping check
solutions.ur: Install ke baad: installation technician se piping check karwaayein

solutions.en: Normal use: power cycle ~5 minutes; if persists request service
solutions.ur: aam astamal: ~5 mnt ry syt baqy rhai to sros

solutions.en: Find installer contact on business card or unit label
solutions.ur: Business card ya unit label par installer ka number nikaalein

notes.en: Same display as CH91 group on official page.
notes.ur: Official page par yeh CH91 group jaisa hi display dikhata hai.

meaning.en: Test-run protection code in same family as CH90; some models show F4.
meaning.ur: CH90 ki hi family ka test-run protection code; kuch models F4 dikhate hain

causes.en: Piping connection problem after install/relocation
causes.ur: Install/relocation ke baad piping connection masla

causes.en: Temporary electrical fault
causes.ur: Bijli ka temporary fault

solutions.en: Installer piping/leak verification
solutions.ur: Installer se piping/leak check karwaayein

solutions.en: Power cycle 5 minutes; if persists service
solutions.ur: 5 mnt ry syt baqy rhai to sros

solutions.en: Do not ignore during commissioning — finish test run correctly
solutions.ur: Commissioning ke dauran ise ignore na karein — test run theek se mukammal karein

notes.ur: Africa official 90/91/92/93 ko CH66 ke sath group karta hai.

title.en: Indoor-outdoor communication unstable at test run
title.ur: Test run par indoor-outdoor communication unstable

meaning.en: Communication between indoor and outdoor not stable during test run; post-2021 models also if outdoor not receiving power.
meaning.ur: Test run par indoor aur outdoor ke darmiyan communication stable nahi; 2021 ke baad ke models mein outdoor ko bijli na milne par bhi aata hai

causes.en: New install / relocation — comms not stable yet
causes.ur: Nayi installation ya shifting — abhi comms stable nahi

causes.en: Outdoor unit not powered (separate power cord models after 2021)
causes.ur: Outdoor unit par bijli nahi (2021 ke baad alag power cord models)

causes.en: Unstable power supply during normal use
causes.ur: Aam istemal ke dauran bijli ka supply stable nahi rehta

solutions.en: Check outdoor power plug firmly in wall outlet (not overloaded power strip)
solutions.ur: Outdoor power plug ko wall socket mein mazbooti se check karein (overloaded power strip na ho)

solutions.en: Check AC circuit breaker is on; do not repeatedly reset a tripping breaker — request service
solutions.ur: AC circuit breaker on hai ya nahi check karein; baar baar tripping breaker reset na karein — service karwaayein

solutions.en: Power cycle 5 minutes if plug/breaker OK; if persists service
solutions.ur: Plug/breaker theek ho to 5 minute power cycle karein; phir bhi rahe to service

notes.en: Africa official includes CH92 in same family; CH92 kept as alias-level note only.
notes.ur: Africa official CH92 ko isi family mein shamil karta hai; CH92 ko sirf alias-level note hi rakha gaya hai.

title.en: Communication error (post-2021 dual power cord architecture)
title.ur: Communication error (2021 ke baad dual power cord architecture)

meaning.en: Error codes CH*** on models where indoor and outdoor each need separate power; both must be energized.
meaning.ur: Jin models mein indoor aur outdoor ko alag alag bijli chahiye, un par CH*** codes tab aate hain jab dono on na hon

causes.en: Outdoor power plug disconnected
causes.ur: Outdoor power plug nikaala hua

causes.en: AC circuit breaker off or will not stay on
causes.ur: AC circuit breaker off hai ya on nahi reh raha

causes.en: Shared multi-plug strip overloaded / not suitable for AC
causes.ur: Aik hi multi-plug strip overloaded ya AC ke liye suitable nahi

solutions.en: Plug outdoor unit directly into wall outlet
solutions.ur: Bahar ke unit ko seedha wall socket mein lagayein

solutions.en: Switch AC breaker on; if breaker will not engage request service (do not force reset)
solutions.ur: AC breaker on karein; breaker on na ho to service karwaayein (zor se reset na karein)

solutions.en: Power cycle 5 minutes if wiring OK
solutions.ur: Wiring sahi ho to 5 minute power cycle karein

notes.en: Image alt chips: 237/238. Guide states all error codes begin CH + number on these models.
notes.ur: Image alt chips 237/238 hain. Guide ke mutabiq in models par tamam error codes CH + number se shuru hote hain.
